title: Cake Cottage | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Cake Cottage is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Nestled within the charming community of Cottages at Eastern Lake, this 5-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom home offers a relaxing retreat while keeping you close to everything 30A has to offer. Accommodating up to 13 guests, it's located in a quiet cul-de-sac just steps from the boardwalk leading to the resort-style community pool. Whether you're unwinding by the water or heading out to explore, this home provides the perfect blend of comfort and convenience.Inside, natural light fills the open living space, where cozy sofas and wing chairs create an inviting spot for movie nights or catching up with loved ones. The fully equipped kitchen has everything you need for home-cooked meals, including a coffee maker, Keurig, microwave, and a refrigerator with an ice maker. Share meals at the dining table with seating for eight or enjoy a casual bite at the kitchen island with six bar stools. Step onto the large screened porch with your morning coffee and let the coastal breeze set the tone for the day ahead, while you enjoy your favorite shows on the TV. The first floor also features a king bedroom with a private bath, plus a half bath and a washer/dryer for added convenience.Upstairs, three more bedrooms provide space for everyone, including a bunk room with four built-in twin beds that kids will love. The oversized master suite offers a private TV, en suite bath, and a spacious balcony, perfect for unwinding after a day of exploring 30A. A bonus flex/game room gives kids their own space to relax after beach adventures.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Level, Bedroom 1: 1 King bed, TV, and a private bathroom.2nd Level, Bedroom 2: 1 King bed, TV, and a private bathroom.2nd Level, Bedroom 3: 2 Twin-over-twin bunk bed, and a bathroom.2nd Level, Bedroom 4: 1 King bed, TV, large private bathroom, and a wide private balcony.*Sofa in the living area pulls out to a queen-sized bed.2nd Level, Bedroom 5: 1 Twin bed, Tv.Outside, fire up the grill on the back porch for a cookout with friends and family. Just steps away, the boardwalk leads to the community pool, offering a great way to cool off in the sun. When you're ready to explore, grab the bikes and beach items from the garage, or hop on the 6-seater golf cart to reach Walton Dunes beach access, where soft sands and clear waters await. Spend the day paddleboarding, biking scenic trails, or browsing local boutiques. After a fun-filled day, indulge in fresh seafood and coastal cuisine at some of 30A’s best restaurants, where you can savor the region’s flavors and laid-back atmosphere. Whether you're seeking adventure or simply looking to slow down and enjoy the moment, this home is the perfect setting for a memorable stay.This home also offers the classic 30A experience with a unique advantage, it's right across the street from Eastern Lake, a rare coastal dune lake where freshwater meets saltwater, creating a perfect spot for fishing. If you love kayaking, local companies can deliver a kayak straight to you, making it easy to spend a fun-filled day on the water with family. Plus, you're just a short 10-minute walk from Old Florida Fish House, where you can enjoy live music by the lake and some of the best dining on 30A, with both indoor and outdoor seating options.Your stay at Cake Cottage comes with Xplorie’s best activities! One ticket per day, per activity! (Over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Please note that there is active construction on the lot next door.Additional Information:*Dog Friendly: A non-refundable pet fee applies. Up to 2 dogs (30 lbs max) allowed. Please contact us if bringing a pet and check our rental policies for details.*Parking for 4 cars.A starter set of amenities includes kitchen supplies, bathroom essentials, and one body towel, washcloth, and hand towel per guest and bathroom.
